verdict.rationale: Google Cloud supports natural-language operation indirectly. First-party MCP servers let AI clients such as Gemini CLI or Claude Code act on Cloud Run resources and deploy apps (docs-16, docs-28, probe-1). The MCP Toolbox for Databases connects agents to databases with NL2SQL tools (gh-1, gh-2, gh-3). Coverage is limited to specific services and depends on a third-party or separate agent client; core gcloud and API access are programmatic, not natural-language. Missing for 10: a native natural-language command interface in the console or CLI, broad coverage of services beyond Cloud Run and databases, and independent hands-on corroboration of NL-driven operation.
